proposal.summary: A malicious snap could inject contents into the input of the controlling terminal using the TIOCLINUX ioctl request, allowing arbitrary commands to be executed outside of the snap sandbox after the snap exits.
proposal.cwe_quote: insufficient validation of snap content interface and layout paths, resulting in the ability for snaps to inject arbitrary AppArmor policy rules via malformed content interface and layout declarations and hence escape strict snap confinement.

AV.quote: can only be exploited when snaps are run on a virtual console.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate and patch the vulnerability in the snapd implementation.
